title: 第3068章 天祖破界阵逆天修炼速度第3067章 手段通天难以置信
slug: 废武魂我逆天进化震惊世界
content_zh:
血魔古祖突然沉默在那里，风祖等人感受到一股极强的压迫感，大气都不敢喘。
他们不由得感谢血魔古祖的不杀之恩。
他们都很清楚，血魔古祖想单凭一己之力对抗大道共济会和黑暗天祖庙就是小丑行为，但想杀他们，抬抬手就够了。
山海之主则是最清楚事实真相的。
他是真的懵了。
分不清，根本分不清苍龙道友到底是黑暗一脉，还是大界生灵了。
若是大界生灵怎么运用黑暗手段比黑暗古祖都熟练？
山海之主嘴里又有些苦涩。
在山海大界他意气风发，乃是无敌的无上祖。
但出了山海大界，才知道外面的世界有多精彩，看着苍龙道友搅风搅雨，一路高歌猛进，他祝福的同时还是有羡慕，妒忌，心酸，挫败在的。
“有意思。”
洛凡尘挑眉，玩味的看向风祖等人：
“说你们大道共济会一般吧。”
“若是这一次我不出手，你们大概率被这十个黑暗天祖灭了。”
“而这些天祖带去不朽长生界围猎那大劫主的手段，也足以让你们大道共济会所有美梦破碎。”
风祖等人面露尴尬之色，根本无力反驳。
只有天音祖师嘴里嘟囔着：“他们身上携带的底牌是第七龛位天孕祖的法旨，而我们身上带的是共济会排名第二的浑源古帝的浑源宝珠，还是我们的胜算更高一些。”
“怎么跟教主说话呢？”山海之主怒斥：“教主目光何等敏锐，岂会看不见你说的东西？”
山海之主经历了一系列复杂的心情，成功摆正了自己的位置，要什么面子？
他要当狗！

他要给苍龙道友当狗！
当最忠诚的狗！
八十岁才开启修行之路，他有着与其他传人不一样的眼光和觉悟。
洛凡尘摇头，没有多说话。
他的颅内多出了一座黑暗无上阵法，虽然不如匿因隐果无上仙阵位格高，但也是极其难得的无上黑暗大阵。
此阵想要布置，需要最少有三十六尊黑暗古祖才行。
此阵名为“天祖极道破界阵”，拥有着强大的攻伐之力，看来天祖庙是铁了心要集结所有黑暗古祖之力，要将那大劫主找出来击杀。
若是此界布置成功，那不朽长生界应该就沦陷了。
“不过……”
洛凡尘唇角微扬。
好巧不巧，此阵落在了他的手里。
他颅内灵光一闪，若是他能在大道宝瓶之中凑够三十六名黑暗古祖的道果之力，不知道能否布置出这“天祖极道破界阵”。
在炎黄大界击杀三个黑暗古祖，在山海大界又杀了三个，再加上如今收拾的十尊黑暗古祖，他掌控的黑暗道果数量已经达到了十六。
洛凡尘舔着嘴唇，目露极致的贪婪之色。
杀！
再杀二十个，试试这出自黑暗天祖庙的顶尖杀阵威力如何。
洛凡尘唇角流露坏笑。
不知道黑暗天祖瞧见他一个大界生灵施展此阵的时候是什么感受？
content_en:
The ancient blood demon ancestor suddenly fell silent. Feng Zu and others felt a strong sense of oppression and did not dare to breathe.
They couldn't help but thank the Blood Demon Ancestor for not killing him.
They all knew that it was a clown act for the Blood Demon Ancestor to fight against the Avenue Freemasonry and the Dark Heavenly Ancestral Temple on his own, but if he wanted to kill them, all he had to do was raise his hand.
The Lord of Mountains and Seas knows the truth best.
He was really confused.
I can't tell, I can't tell whether Fellow Daoist Canglong is of the dark lineage or a creature from the great world.
How can a creature from the great world use dark methods more skillfully than the ancient dark ancestors?
The Lord of Mountains and Seas felt a little bitter in his mouth.
In the world of mountains and seas, he is vigorous and vigorous, and is the invincible supreme ancestor.
But after leaving the world of mountains and seas, I realized how wonderful the outside world is. Watching fellow Taoist Canglong stirring up troubles and making great progress all the way, while blessing him, he was still filled with envy, jealousy, sadness, and frustration.
"Interesting."
Luo Fanchen raised his eyebrows and looked at Feng Zu and others playfully:
"Let's just say you are just like a Freemason."
"If I don't take action this time, you will most likely be destroyed by these ten Dark Heavenly Ancestors."
"And the methods these Heavenly Ancestors brought to the Immortal Realm to hunt down the Great Tribulation Lord are enough to shatter all the dreams of your Grand Dao Freemasonry."
Feng Zu and others looked embarrassed, unable to refute at all.
Only Patriarch Tianyin muttered: "The trump card they carry is the decree of the Seventh Niche Tianyuan Ancestor, and what we carry is the Hunyuan Orb of Hunyuan Ancient Emperor, who ranks second in the Freemasonry. Our chances of winning are higher."
"How can you talk to the leader?" The Lord of Mountains and Seas yelled angrily: "The leader has such keen eyesight, how could he not see what you are saying?"
The Lord of Mountains and Seas has gone through a series of complicated emotions and successfully positioned himself. What kind of face does he need?
He wants to be a dog!
He wants to be a dog for fellow Taoist Canglong!
Be the most loyal dog!
He did not start the path of spiritual practice until he was eighty years old. He has a different vision and awareness from other successors.
Luo Fanchen shook his head and said nothing.
There is a supreme dark formation in his skull. Although it is not as high as the Supreme Immortal Formation of Hidden Causes and Hidden Fruits, it is still an extremely rare supreme dark formation.
To set up this formation, you need at least thirty-six Dark Ancestors.
This formation is called the "Tianzu Ji Dao Boundary Breaking Formation" and has powerful offensive power. It seems that Tianzu Temple is determined to gather the power of all the dark ancestors to find and kill the great tribulation master.
If the arrangement of this world is successful, the immortal world should have fallen.
"But..."
The corners of Luo Fanchen's lips raised slightly.
By coincidence, this formation fell into his hands.
A flash of inspiration flashed inside his head. If he could gather the power of the Dao Fruit of the thirty-six dark ancient ancestors in the Dao Treasure Vase, he didn't know if he could arrange this "Heavenly Ancestor Extreme Dao Boundary Breaking Formation".
Killing three dark ancient ancestors in the Yanhuang world, and killing three more in the mountain and sea world, plus the ten dark ancient ancestors he has taken care of now, the number of dark Dao fruits he controls has reached sixteen.
Luo Fanchen licked his lips, showing extreme greed.
kill!
Kill another twenty and try out the power of this top-notch killing array from the Dark Tianzu Temple.
Luo Fanchen's lips revealed a wicked smile.
I wonder how Dark Heavenly Ancestor felt when he saw a great world creature like him perform this formation?
